newsitem.title: USA: Port of Mobile, Ala. reopens to traffic.
newsitem.headline: Port of Mobile, Ala. reopens to traffic.

text.p: The port of Mobile, Ala., which was closed late last week because it was in the path of Hurricane Danny, has reopened to vessel traffic early on Tuesday, the U.S. Coast Guard said.

"The port of Mobile has been reopened to all vessel traffic with the exception of deep draft vessels as of 9:48 CDT Tuesday morning," Lt. Jr Grade L. Parks U.S. Coast Guard told Reuters in a telephone interview.
He noted as of now deep draft vessels were restricted to one-way traffic from the mouth of the Mobile ship channel to the port of the city of Mobile.
The port was closed to all vessel traffic as of late Friday due to Hurricane Danny which hit Mobile, Parks said.
"There was no traffic jam or backlog in the ship channel because vessels were warned beforehand. Radio broadcasts were made late last week prior to Danny arriving in Mobile," Parks said.
